# Google Antigravity plugin package

This generated P-ASES package has an Antigravity-specific root `plugin.json` and the canonical 16 host-neutral Skills under `skills/`. The plugin slug is `p-ases`. Third-party GitHub marketplace support has not been confirmed, so install locally from `dist/antigravity` or use the versioned Antigravity Release ZIP with `SHA256SUMS`. Load the package with an Antigravity 2.0 CLI or IDE installation to run a product smoke test.

To use the CLI from a consumer checkout, install this directory with `python -m pip install /path/to/dist/antigravity`, then run `python -m p_ases --help`. `python -m p_ases project status` reads an existing profile without initializing or changing it. The source of truth is `workflow/`, `runtime/p_ases/`, and this adapter. Run `python tools/build_dist.py` after editing canonical files.

Host-managed worktree support in Antigravity is unverified. With `workspace.isolation=auto`, the `work-execution` Skill uses the current-checkout flow; `required` blocks before source edits when no verified native isolation capability is available.


For the one-time `puchinya/ai-agent-workflow` Issue #63 / PR #64 adoption, complete and push bootstrap implementation and pass exact-final-HEAD Required CI before presenting the full immutable adoption plan. A distinct direct same-conversation Owner approval for that exact plan must reach the authenticated V3 in-process route before apply. If the active Antigravity host does not expose the actual user-role event, stop with `CHAT_PROVENANCE_UNAVAILABLE`; never claim adoption or produce ordinary PASS evidence before that path succeeds. Do not recreate a missing historical V1 Binding. After adoption, Independent Review binds `execution-adoption:<epoch-sha256>` and all normal current-HEAD gates remain required. The adoption decision is not User Review, Ruleset, Activation, or merge authorization.

The host owns one lifecycle orchestration for ordinary single/child Issues: exact approved ADC/rebaseline and Binding, specification/design/Test Oracle receipts, `ready`, `execution`, implementation, current Verification/Acceptance/Self-Audit and fresh native Independent Review, then `verification`, Review Readiness, and `user-review start`. Keep fixes for blocking Independent Review findings in `execution`; each changed HEAD needs a fresh child. Do not move verification back to execution implicitly. Runtime commands remain one-shot mutations and readbacks. Readiness cannot PASS before verification or while any `attention:*` label is present; attention is cleared only through the existing attention workflow. User Review validates exact kind/phase/attention before writes, and re-reads all three before its label update. A lost label-write response is resolved by exact full-label readback without repeating a confirmed write. In `user-review`, Readiness can only recompute the same subject/Readiness SHA already held by its immutable session. Start/sync resumes an exact interrupted session without changing `started_at`. Treat `PENDING` (exit code 2) as `WAITING_USER_REVIEW_DECISION` only after session, complete snapshot, and `phase:user-review` readback; no approval is implied.

Native subagent delegation and host-reported reviewer provenance in Antigravity are unverified. Independent Review requires the host to create and join a dedicated fresh child. The child-authored existing context artifact records host `spawn_session_id`, `reviewer_id`, and `implementation_binding_id` as compact canonical JSON in its `provenance` string; the parent checks these against host metadata and the current binding, then ingests the unchanged artifact through the existing `audit independent` route. Until native delegation and these provenance values are verified on the active surface, stop with `INDEPENDENT_SUBAGENT_UNAVAILABLE`; do not substitute a same-context second prompt, a human fallback, or User Review.
